title: Multi-stage builds and a minimal base image

videos.script: Ana's image is one point four gigabytes, for one small program. Almost all of it is the compiler, which nobody needs at run time. {{stages}} A second FROM line fixes that. The first stage builds, the second copies out one file. The same program now ships in twenty-eight megabytes, on a base with no shell at all. {{scratch}} Then a trap. On an empty base the program refuses to start, with a message about a file that is plainly there. The missing file is the C library's loader, and one variable removes the need for it. {{target}} And two options that pick from the same Dockerfile: a stage to run the tests in, and one tag holding an image for each processor.
